name: Four Seasons Cairo at The First Residence
positioning: Classical, French Empire-style luxury hotel on the west bank of the Nile in Giza
best_for: Travelers who want a Nile-side base for the Pyramids

facts.text: Opened May 2000: 262 rooms (212 guest rooms and 50 suites) across 20 stories.
Located at 35 Giza Street on the west bank of the Nile, flanked by the Zoological and Botanical Gardens, with the Great Pyramid in the distance.
Architecture and decor are reminiscent of French Empire style, with polished woods, gilt finishes and Egyptian motifs; a signature round stained-glass window lights the lobby lounge.
The hotel is in Giza's First Mall complex, which has high-end boutiques.

Dining includes Aura (Lebanese mezze and grills), Nairu (dim sum and Indian dishes), Xodo (Brazilian churrascaria), Zoe (seafood and beef, outdoor seating), Char Bar, La Gourmandise, Tea Lounge and The First Bar.
Dining is also offered aboard the First Nile Boat, with panoramic Nile views and international cuisine.
The spa has large round windows overlooking the Nile, a private couples suite and a Turkish hammam.
The hotel has two pools and a fitness centre open 24 hours, with a ladies-only gym.

highlights.text: Rooms offer glimpses of the Nile or the Great Pyramids; Premier Rooms, the largest guest rooms, look over the Botanical Gardens.
Premium Suites are on the fifth floor with a fully equipped kitchenette and large living space, described as ideal for family stays.
Four Seasons can arrange a private dinner by the Pyramids as an off-site event.
The kitchens use locally sourced ingredients such as Sayadeya sea bass, molokeya (Egyptian spinach), Red Sea seafood, olive oil and dates.

considerations.text: The Pyramids are seen only in the distance or as a glimpse from some rooms; the hotel is a city base, not beside the Pyramids.
The decor is grand French Empire style with gilt finishes, not a contemporary minimalist look. The hotel opened in 2000.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
Golf, horseback riding and tennis are off-site activities.
